+"""Live storage agents for task websites. Queries read saved observations, never browse or infer facts."""
+import asyncio
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from swarm import timeline
+from swarm.agent import Agent
+
+RESULT_KEYS = {"brief", "sites", "tender", "quantities", "spec", "requirements", "requirements_final",
+               "erp", "materials", "mail", "mailbox", "discount", "gaps", "verification", "bid_draft"}
+TEXT_LIMIT = 4000
+
+
+class SiteMemoryAgent(Agent):
+    """One persistent memory per website; available synchronously even while its storage loop is busy."""
+    def __init__(self, ctx, site_id: str, directory: Path | None = None):
+        super().__init__(ctx)
+        self.site_id = site_id
+        self.name = f"SiteMemory:{site_id}"
+        self.directory = directory
+        self._cursor = 0
+        self._records: dict[str, dict] = {}
+
+    def sync(self) -> None:
+        evidence = self.ctx.board.evidence
+        for item in evidence[self._cursor:]:
+            if item.site != self.site_id:
+                continue
+            identity = item.evidence_id
+            if identity in self._records:
+                writers = self._records[identity]["authors"]
+                if item.author and item.author not in writers:
+                    writers.append(item.author)
+                continue
+            self._records[identity] = {"id": identity, **asdict(item), "authors": [item.author] if item.author else []}
+        self._cursor = len(evidence)
+
+    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
+        self.sync()
+        return {"site": self.site_id, "revision": self.ctx.board.revision,
+                "evidence": copy.deepcopy(list(self._records.values()))}
+
+    def save(self) -> None:
+        if self.directory is None:
+            return
+        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        filename = hashlib.sha256(self.site_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16] + ".json"
+        target = self.directory / filename
+        temporary = target.with_suffix(".tmp")
+        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(self.snapshot(), ensure_ascii=False, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
+        temporary.replace(target)
+
+    async def run(self) -> None:
+        timeline.event("memory.start", agent=self.name, site=self.site_id)
+        try:
+            while True:
+                revision = self.ctx.board.revision
+                self.save()
+                # Coalesce a burst of page/analyst updates into one snapshot, without polling an idle memory.
+                try:
+                    await self.ctx.board.wait_changed(revision, timeout=30)
+                    await asyncio.sleep(5)
+                except TimeoutError:
+                    pass
+        finally:
+            self.save()
+            timeline.event("memory.end", agent=self.name, site=self.site_id)
+
+
+class SiteMemories:
+    def __init__(self, ctx, directory: Path | None = None):
+        self.ctx = ctx
+        self.agents = {site: SiteMemoryAgent(ctx, site, directory) for site in ctx.site_ids}
+
+    def query(self, *, consumer: str, site: str = "", query: str = "", evidence_id: str = "",
+              kind: str = "", limit: int = 5, offset: int = 0, result_key: str = "") -> dict:
+        """Return bounded excerpts with provenance. Select an id and offset to read the rest of a long page."""
+        if site and site not in self.agents:
+            return {"error": "Unknown task website", "sites": list(self.agents)}
+        if result_key:
+            if result_key not in RESULT_KEYS:
+                return {"error": "Unsupported analysis result", "result_keys": sorted(RESULT_KEYS)}
+            value = json.dumps(self.ctx.board.get(result_key), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
+            start = max(0, offset)
+            return {"result_key": result_key, "revision": self.ctx.board.revision, "text": value[start:start + 20000],
+                    "next_offset": start + 20000 if len(value) > start + 20000 else None,
+                    "note": "Analyst interpretation; consult source evidence before resolving conflicts."}
+        terms = re.findall(r"\w+", query.casefold())
+        candidates = []
+        for memory in self.agents.values():
+            if site and memory.site_id != site:
+                continue
+            memory.sync()
+            for record in memory._records.values():
+                if evidence_id and record["id"] != evidence_id:
+                    continue
+                if kind and not record["kind"].startswith(kind):
+                    continue
+                text = json.dumps(record["data"], ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
+                haystack = (record["kind"] + " " + record["source"] + " " + text).casefold()
+                score = sum(term in haystack for term in terms)
+                if terms and score == 0:
+                    continue
+                candidates.append((score, record["ts"], record, text))
+        candidates.sort(key=lambda row: (row[0], row[1]), reverse=True)
+        start = max(0, offset)
+        selected = candidates[:max(1, min(5, limit))] if evidence_id else candidates[start:start + max(1, min(5, limit))]
+        out = []
+        for _, _, record, text in selected:
+            char_start = start if evidence_id else 0
+            out.append({k: record[k] for k in ("id", "kind", "site", "source", "author", "authors", "note", "ts")}
+                       | {"text": text[char_start:char_start + TEXT_LIMIT], "chars": len(text),
+                          "next_offset": char_start + TEXT_LIMIT if len(text) > char_start + TEXT_LIMIT else None})
+            timeline.record_memory_query(consumer, record["author"], site=record["site"])
+        timeline.event("memory.query", agent=consumer, site=site or "*", matches=len(out))
+        return {"evidence": out, "matches": len(candidates), "revision": self.ctx.board.revision,
+                "next_offset": start + len(out) if not evidence_id and start + len(out) < len(candidates) else None,
+                "sites": list(self.agents), "result_keys": sorted(RESULT_KEYS),
+                "note": "Observed versions and caveats are preserved. Newest observation does not imply authority."}
+
+    def bid_snapshot(self, keys) -> dict:
+        """Freeze analyst inputs and a source manifest after collection and verification have settled."""
+        sources = {}
+        for site, agent in self.agents.items():
+            snap = agent.snapshot()
+            sources[site] = [{k: e[k] for k in ("id", "kind", "source", "authors", "note", "ts")}
+                             for e in snap["evidence"]]
+        return {"revision": self.ctx.board.revision,
+                "inputs": copy.deepcopy({key: self.ctx.board.get(key) for key in keys}), "sources": sources,
+                "gaps": copy.deepcopy(self.ctx.board.get("gaps") or []),
+                "verification": copy.deepcopy(self.ctx.board.get("verification") or {})}
+
+
+def memories(ctx, directory: Path | None = None) -> SiteMemories:
+    if "site_memories" not in ctx.shared:
+        ctx.shared["site_memories"] = SiteMemories(ctx, directory)
+    return ctx.shared["site_memories"]
